title: A multi-level multi-label text classification dataset of 19th century Ottoman and Russian literary and critical texts
reasoning: The paper introduces a classification dataset that includes specific labels for 'Ethics', 'Morality', and 'Religion/Secularism' within its hierarchical taxonomy. Furthermore, it benchmarks the performance of various models, including Large Language Models, on these specific philosophical and religious subject categories (as shown in Table 4 and the detailed taxonomy figures in the appendix).
